parts:
Last night was one for the books. ☘️  

We headed out to **The Caverns in Pelham, TN** to see **Boxing Banjo** play, and it was absolutely incredible. The music, the energy, the people… it felt like the perfect way to get our *Irish on* before my surgery on **St. Patrick’s Day** so we didn’t have to miss out on the fun festivities.  

There’s just something magical about live Irish music underground in a cave. Fiddles, banjos, and a whole lot of Irish jigging echoing through the cavern walls. It felt like everyone there was part of the same celebration.  

And honestly, every adventure together just keeps getting better. The kind that ends up etched into your memory forever. These are the moments that remind me how special it is to have someone who will dance, laugh, and explore right alongside you.  

A huge thank you to our sweet friend for **gifting us these tickets** and making this whole weekend possible. Because of you, we got to spend a fantastic weekend tucked away in the woods, enjoying our tiny house among the trees, great music, and time together that I’ll never forget.  

Good music.  
Good company.  
A little Irish spirit.  

And a weekend adventure I’ll always be grateful for. ☘️💚
